description: Cedar shakes and shingles, which are thin, tapered pieces of cedar wood used for roofing and siding.
hts_note: Cedar shakes and shingles for roofing and siding are classified under shingles and shakes of red cedar.

description: Cedar shakes and shingles, typically used for roofing and siding applications.
hts_note: Classified under subheading 4418.50.0010 which specifically covers wooden shingles and shakes made of cedar.

description: Wildcat Plus Tex 35 sewing thread made of polyester textured yarn.
hts_note: Classified as sewing thread of synthetic filaments under heading 5401.

description: Two types of tubing for intermediate bulk container cages that do not have a rectangular (including square) cross section.
hts_note: Welded tubing of circular cross section made of nonalloy steel, commonly used in intermediate bulk container cages, with a wall thickness exceeding 1.65 mm.

description: Individual spring modules sold and packaged as single springs, rather than joined together as an assembled unit.
hts_note: Individual, unassembled steel helical coil springs are classified under heading 7320 as helical springs of iron or steel.

description: Rear quarter finishers, rubber seals, waist finishers, belt moldings, and outer waist belts designed for automotive applications, some of which contain extruded aluminum and others that do not.
hts_note: Automotive body moldings, trim, and weatherstrip finishers are classified as other parts and accessories of motor vehicle bodies.

description: Twelve models of folding door kits designed for assembly into complete folding doors.
hts_note: Folding door kits composed of plastic (PVC) designed for assembly into complete doors are classified as builders' ware of plastics.

description: Wildcat Plus Tex 35 sewing thread, a form of polyester textured yarn used for sewing applications.
hts_note: Sewing thread of synthetic filaments, specifically polyester, is classified under heading 5401.

description: Eleven models of insulated staples (models JY01-01 through JY11-01) collated using plastic insulators that create a distinct space between each staple rather than being joined by glue, adhesive, or paper tape.
hts_note: Insulated steel staples comprised of a metal staple and a plastic insulator are classified as staples of iron or steel made of two or more pieces.

description: PowerXT photovoltaic cells and modules, comprising solar cells with a functioning p/n junction that are assembled into photovoltaic modules.
hts_note: Photovoltaic cells assembled into modules with functioning p/n junctions are classified as crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules under subheading 8541.43.

description: Four window wall kits containing components designed to be assembled into finished window walls.
hts_note: Unassembled window wall kits are classified by GRI 2(a) as finished aluminum windows and their frames.

description: Diamond sawblades consisting of a central core joined with cutting segments, designed for cutting hard materials.
hts_note: Diamond sawblades with cutting segments of agglomerated diamond on a base metal core are classified under heading 6804 as grinding wheels/cutting discs of agglomerated synthetic or natural diamond.

description: Passenger vehicle wheels featuring distinct bolt patterns, positive offsets, distinct pilot diameters, and load ratings suitable for passenger vehicles rather than trailers or towable equipment.
hts_note: Road wheels designed for passenger motor vehicles of heading 8703 are classified under subheading 8708.70.45.

description: Passenger vehicle and light truck rims and discs featuring larger offsets, specific hub bore sizes, multiple bolt patterns, or lower load ratings that make them unsuitable for use on trailers or towable equipment.
hts_note: Classified as parts of road wheels (rims) for passenger vehicles and light trucks under heading 8708.

description: A farrowing flooring system and pig farrowing crate, including the steel decking of a tribar truss floor and other associated flooring and crate components.
hts_note: Classified as other agricultural or animal husbandry machinery under heading 8436.

description: Ductile cast iron flooring produced from a mold to form a solid, one-piece grating.
hts_note: Cast ductile iron grating is classified as an other cast article of iron or steel, specifically of cast iron other than nonmalleable cast iron.

description: Diamond sawblades composed of cores joined with diamond segments, used for cutting operations.
hts_note: Diamond sawblades consisting of a metal core with cutting segments of agglomerated synthetic or natural diamond are classified under heading 6804 per Note 1(d) to Chapter 82.

description: Model DRS18100 collated insulated steel staples, collated using plastic insulators that create a distinct space between each staple rather than using glue, adhesive, or paper tape.
hts_note: Classified under HTSUS 7317.00.2000 as steel staples of two or more pieces (steel staple with plastic insulator), excluded from heading 8305 because they are not conventional staples in strips.

description: Medicine cabinets with moveable shelves, designated under model numbers #HF01-MAT-WH and #HF01-MAT-ES.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden household furniture, commonly encompassing MDF medicine cabinets.

description: Solar modules assembled using solar cells produced from unfinished silicon wafers that have p/n junctions.
hts_note: Photovoltaic cells of crystalline silicon assembled into modules or made up into panels are classified under this subheading.

description: Individually quick frozen diced garlic measuring one-eighth of an inch.
hts_note: Classified as frozen garlic under heading 0710 as other vegetables, uncooked or cooked by steaming or boiling in water.

description: PowerXT photovoltaic cells and modules used for solar energy generation, featuring solar cells with a functioning p/n junction assembled into modules.
hts_note: Photovoltaic cells assembled into modules or made up into panels are specifically classified under subheading 8541.43.00.

description: Couplers used for self-drilling anchor bolt systems, which are not designed to connect pipes and cannot convey fluid at high pressure.
hts_note: Internally threaded steel couplers for connecting anchor rods are classified as other threaded articles of iron or steel.

description: Flat bulk continuous filament yarn produced from polybutylene terephthalate.
hts_note: Bulk continuous filament (BCF) yarn made of polybutylene terephthalate (a polyester) is classified as textured polyester carpet yarn.

description: Fifteen models of self-drilling anchor bolt system couplers, which are not designed to connect pipes and cannot convey fluid at high pressure.
hts_note: Threaded steel couplers used to connect anchor bolts are classified as other threaded articles of iron or steel.

description: Passenger vehicle wheel model number X45477, featuring specific dimensions for hub bore size, offset measurement, and load rating.
hts_note: Classified as steel road wheels designed for passenger motor vehicles under heading 8708.

description: Crushed glass surface products.
hts_note: Crushed glass engineered surface slabs or countertops bound with cementitious or polymeric binders are typically classified as articles of artificial stone under heading 6810.

description: Individually quick frozen (IQF) garlic cloves.
hts_note: Individually quick frozen garlic cloves are classified as frozen vegetables, other under heading 0710.

description: Zinc and nylon masonry anchors consisting of a zinc, steel, or nylon body component and a steel pin component, designed for installation into pre-drilled holes.
hts_note: Zinc-bodied masonry drive anchors with steel pins derive their essential character from the zinc anchor body, which expands to provide holding power, classifying them as other articles of zinc.

description: Strike pin anchors consisting of four components: a steel pin, a threaded body, a nut, and a flat washer. The anchors are unitary articles that require pre-drilled holes for installation.
hts_note: Strike pin anchors composed of a steel body, pin, nut, and washer are classified as other threaded articles of iron or steel.

description: Individually quick frozen (IQF) 1/8-inch diced garlic and IQF garlic puree.
hts_note: Uncooked or simply processed frozen garlic falls under heading 0710 as frozen vegetables.

description: Three label tapes consisting of narrow woven ribbon with woven selvedge.
hts_note: Narrow woven ribbons with woven selvedges, lacking inscription or design, are classified as narrow woven fabrics of man-made fibers under heading 5806.

description: Split-drive masonry anchors designed for fastening into masonry substrates that require pre-drilled holes for installation.
hts_note: Split-drive masonry anchors are non-threaded iron or steel fastening articles that expand mechanically upon insertion into pre-drilled holes.

description: Crimp drive masonry anchors designed for fastening that require pre-drilled holes for installation.
hts_note: Crimp drive masonry anchors are non-threaded iron or steel expansion fasteners installed into pre-drilled holes.

description: Stamped circular disc blanks made of aluminum, stamped or punched into non-rectangular shapes rather than coils or cut-to-length sheets, designed to be pressed into circular vessels such as pots and pans.
hts_note: Aluminum discs or circles punched into non-rectangular shapes with a thickness exceeding 0.2 mm but less than 4.75 mm are classified under heading 7606 as non-alloyed aluminum circles.

description: Decorative ceramic tile mosaic pieces made from porcelain, shaped in heart, star, circle, and petal forms.
hts_note: Classified as porcelain ceramic mosaic pieces with a water absorption coefficient not exceeding 0.5% under heading 6907.

description: Craft dowels made of wood that are continuously shaped.
hts_note: Craft dowels made of non-coniferous wood that are continuously shaped and rounded along their length are classified as continuously shaped wood under heading 4409.

description: Twenty-one base shells made of steel, consisting of mechanical tubing or cold-drawn tubing.
hts_note: Classified as seamless cold-drawn circular mechanical tubing of nonalloy steel.

description: Twenty-one base shells made of circular welded non-alloy steel that constitute mechanical tubing or are cold drawn.
hts_note: Classified as other welded tubes of circular cross-section, of non-alloy steel, consisting of cold-drawn or cold-rolled mechanical tubing.

description: Steel mobile home skirting spikes, imported under SKU number NP100S and as part of the SKU KNP100S mobile home skirting kit, designed for securing mobile home skirting.
hts_note: Classified as other steel nails, tacks, or similar securing spikes of one piece or fabricated steel under heading 7317.

description: Six wooden chests designed for use as accent furniture.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture, not of a kind used in offices, kitchens, or bedrooms.

description: Solid sawn wood planking designed for use as exterior siding that is not made of laminated veneer lumber (LVL) or finger-jointed wood.
hts_note: Classified under heading 4409 as continuously shaped coniferous wood siding.

description: Exterior siding products consisting of solid sawn wood planks that are not laminated veneer lumber (LVL) and are not finger-jointed.
hts_note: Exterior solid wood siding continuously shaped along its edges or faces is classified under heading 4409 as coniferous wood siding.

description: Dual-piston internal combustion engines.
hts_note: Classified as other spark-ignition reciprocating internal combustion piston engines, not specified for vehicles or marine propulsion.

description: T-series aluminum sheet, which is a flat, multi-alloy, clad aluminum sheet produced with a 3XXX-series core and having a thickness greater than 0.2 mm but no greater than 6.3 mm.
hts_note: Classified as rectangular clad aluminum alloy sheet with a thickness exceeding 0.2 mm but not exceeding 6.3 mm under heading 7606.

description: Uncoated paper rolls, commonly known as sheeter rolls, weighing between 40 and 150 grams per square meter, that are white paper with a GE brightness level of 83 +/- 1% or higher, or colored paper. The rolls typically measure between 52 and 103 inches in width and 50 inches in diameter, designed to be converted into individual sheets of uncoated paper using cutting machinery prior to printing.
hts_note: Classified as uncoated writing or printing paper, containing 10% or less mechanical fibers, in large rolls weighing between 40 g/m2 and 150 g/m2.

description: Welded oil country tubular goods completed from steel inputs, used in oil and gas extraction operations.
hts_note: Classified as welded casing of iron or nonalloy steel of a kind used in drilling for oil or gas under heading 7306.

description: Uncoated paper rolls, commonly known as sheeter rolls, weighing between 40 and 150 grams per square meter, in white with a GE brightness level of 83 +/-1 percent or higher or in colored paper, typically measuring between 52 and 103 inches wide and 50 inches in diameter. The rolls are designed for conversion into individual sheets of uncoated paper using specialized cutting machinery prior to printing.
hts_note: Uncoated paper of a kind used for writing, printing or other graphic purposes, in rolls wider than 15 cm and weighing between 40 g/m2 and 150 g/m2, not elsewhere specified.

description: Uncoated paper rolls, commonly known as sheeter rolls, weighing between 40 and 150 grams per square meter, consisting of white paper with a GE brightness level of 83 +/-1% or higher, or colored paper. The rolls typically measure between 52 and 103 inches in width and 50 inches in diameter, and are intended for conversion into individual sheets using specialized cutting machinery prior to printing.
hts_note: Classified as uncoated woodfree paper for writing or printing, in rolls exceeding 31.75 cm in width, weighing 60 g/m² to 150 g/m².
